in_marathi.name: Arohan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aroha’ which means ‘progress’ or ‘advancement’. This name signifies the upward journey of the soul towards spiritual growth and self-realization. It is believed to bring success, prosperity, and good fortune to the one who bears this name.
